$to_be_done.description: All known issues, inconsistencies, security problems, and pending implementations. Work through these systematically - step by step we reach the moon.

items.issue: Hardcoded Windows debug path in production code
items.detail: file_put_contents('C:/Users/User/Local Sites/apollorio/...') hardcoded debug write. Will fail silently on any non-Windows or non-matching path server. Must be removed or gated behind if (WP_DEBUG).
items.fix: Remove the file_put_contents call or wrap in if (defined('WP_DEBUG') && WP_DEBUG) { ... }
items.resolution_note: Re-audited 2026-05-20: current AppAuthController.php contains no file_put_contents or hardcoded Windows path.

items.detail: Lines L1191 and L1193 contain direct variable interpolation in SQL queries. SQL injection risk.
items.fix: Wrap all SQL queries with $wpdb->prepare() and use placeholders (%s, %d)

items.detail: Plugin.php L1185 and Admin.php L304 have raw SQL with variable interpolation.
items.fix: Use $wpdb->prepare() for all parameterized queries

items.detail: Deactivation.php L56 uses direct variable in SQL query.
items.fix: Use $wpdb->prepare() even in deactivation/cleanup hooks

items.issue: Nonces exposed in data-* HTML attributes
items.detail: 10 instances across 9 plugins where WordPress nonces are output as data-* attribute values in rendered HTML. Nonces should only be in JS config blocks (wp_json_encode) for logged-in users, never in the DOM.
items.fix: Move nonces to wp_json_encode() JS config block, guard with is_user_logged_in(), remove from data-* attributes

items.detail: At least one REST endpoint in apollo-groups uses __return_true as permission_callback, allowing unauthenticated mutations.
items.fix: Replace __return_true with proper capability check (is_user_logged_in, current_user_can, etc.) on all write endpoints

items.issue: Missing CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER on Instagram profile cURL
items.detail: get_instagram_profile_pic() method fetches Instagram avatar without CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER = true. Man-in-the-middle attack risk on profile picture fetching.
items.fix: Add curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true) to the cURL setup

items.detail: 6 HIGH unescaped echo instances across apollo-djs templates. Output not wrapped in esc_html() or esc_attr().
items.fix: Wrap all dynamic template output with appropriate escape functions: esc_html(), esc_attr(), esc_url(), wp_kses_post()

items.detail: Admin dashboard template has unescaped dynamic output.
items.fix: Use esc_html() or esc_attr() on all echoed values

items.detail: Digital signature stamp template outputs dynamic data without escaping.
items.fix: Escape all output with esc_html() or wp_kses_post() as appropriate

items.issue: Email verification REST endpoints not implemented
items.detail: /auth/verify-email and /auth/resend-verification are registered in the registry and have handler stubs in EmailVerification.php but are not fully implemented. Email verification flow is incomplete.
items.fix: Implement email sending, token generation, and verification logic in EmailVerification.php REST endpoints
items.resolution_note: Stale as of 2026-05-20: AuthController registers POST /auth/verify-email and /auth/resend-verification with full callbacks; fires apollo/login/verification_email.

items.issue: nopriv AJAX handler should be restricted
items.detail: apollo-fav has a nopriv (unauthenticated) AJAX handler that should require authentication to prevent unauthenticated favorite writes.
items.fix: Change wp_ajax_nopriv_{action} to wp_ajax_{action} (authenticated only) and add is_user_logged_in() check

items.detail: Hub link blocks stored as JSON are written without schema/type validation, allowing arbitrary data structures.
items.fix: Add JSON schema validation before saving hub blocks. Define allowed fields and types.

items.detail: The newsletter subscription endpoint has no rate limiting, allowing email harvest abuse.
items.fix: Add IP-based rate limiting via apollo-login RateLimiter class on the subscribe endpoint

items.issue: Capability check unverified on toggle metric endpoint
items.detail: PUT /stats/metric/{slug}/toggle should require manage_options but capability verification path is unclear in current code.
items.fix: Add explicit current_user_can('manage_options') check in the permission_callback of the toggle endpoint

items.issue: IP rate-limit tier not reset on successful login
items.detail: When a user successfully authenticates, the IP-level rate limiting tier counter is not reset to 0. A user who was rate-limited and then succeeds still carries the old tier state.
items.fix: In AuthController::login() on success path, call RateLimiter::reset($ip) to clear the tier for the IP

items.detail: archive-classified.php, single-classified.php, and create-classified.php template files are absent. Pages rely on future template creation or apollo-classifieds marketplace page integration.
items.fix: Create the 3 missing frontend templates following Apollo Canvas template pattern

items.detail: achievements.php, points.php, ranks.php, and leaderboard.php public-facing templates are not present in apollo-membership/templates/. Registry pages remain planned but unbuilt.
items.fix: Create the 4 missing page templates using Apollo Canvas pattern and Apollo CDN

items.detail: 22 console.log() calls and 15 unguarded error_log() calls found across the codebase (from 2026-04-03 audit). These should not exist in production code.
items.fix: Remove all console.log() from production JS files. Wrap all error_log() with if (WP_DEBUG) { ... }

items.issue: apollo-suppliers meta keys registered but plugin absent
items.detail: apollo-core config registers supplier CPT and meta keys (apollo-core/config/cpts.php) as fallback bridge, but the apollo-suppliers plugin directory does not exist in this installation.
items.fix: When apollo-suppliers is installed, its CPT/meta will auto-activate. No immediate fix needed, but document as expected behavior.

items.detail: APOLLO_ALL_ROUTES lists /feed pointing to feed.php, but current plugin template is explore.php serving /explore and /mural routes. Feed route may be an alias or legacy reference.
items.fix: Confirm whether /feed should alias to explore.php or be removed. Update APOLLO_ALL_ROUTES and registry accordingly.
